# laravelforge_server_php_cli_version (Data Source)

Fetches the default CLI PHP version of a Laravel Forge server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server whose CLI PHP version is read.

### Read-Only

- `binary_name` (String) Name of the PHP binary (e.g. `php82`).
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `status` (String) Installation status of the PHP version.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
- `version` (String) Active CLI PHP version.
